records.title: POSCO TJ Park Foundation Global Scholarship

source.raw_extract:
#### *POSCO Global Scholarship*, empowering global talents and building a better future together.

The POSCO TJ Park Foundation operates the *POSCO Global Scholarship program* to promote mutual understanding through global talent exchange and collaboration.

Key initiatives include :
**- POSCO Global Scholarship in Korea** : an in-bound scholarship that invites global talents to Korea and supports master's/doctorate degree acquisition.
**- Scholarship for Global Universities** : Support for outstanding students currently enrolled in leading universities around the world.
**- POSCO Overseas Fellowship** : Support for oustanding Korean students pursuing degrees at leading universities worldwide.
source.notes: The record's official_source_url (the POSCO Global Scholarship 'Purpose' page) was fetched in full and contains NO deadline, no cycle, and no application timing of any kind - it is a descriptive page listing the programme's three component initiatives. No amount is therefore recoverable for this umbrella record. The Foundation publishes month-level selection timing only on the separate 'POSCO Global Scholarship in Korea' component page (https://www.postf.org/en/asia/abroad/business), which is a distinct sub-programme and is researched separately as record 553 in this shard; per AGENT_BRIEF section 5 a sibling programme's timing must not be borrowed for this record. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY FLAG: the shard's cached deadline_display for this record reads 'Typically May annually'. That wording appears nowhere on any POSCO TJ Park Foundation page fetched (purpose, program, FAQ), and nothing on the Foundation's site supports a May deadline - the previously cached value has no live official source behind it and should not be trusted or re-derived.

rejected_sources.reason: Month-level selection timing published here belongs to the distinct 'POSCO Global Scholarship in Korea' component (record 553), not to this umbrella programme record. Borrowed per AGENT_BRIEF section 5 prohibition on another programme's deadline.
The 'Submission of Application' tab renders empty server-side ('No List') - its content is JavaScript-loaded and no deadline text is retrievable from the live page.

records.record_status_recommendation: programme suspended by the Rhodes Trust Board of Trustees - no Global constituency application deadline exists; recommend the record be closed/quarantined rather than kept open

source.raw_extract:
### **Important Notice Regarding the Global Rhodes Scholarships:**

Please note that the Board of Trustees have decided to suspend the awarding of Global Rhodes Scholarships with immediate effect due to shifting strategic priorities.  

We understand that this will be disappointing to those hoping to apply to the Global Scholarship this year. Alternative funding opportunities available for graduate study at the University of Oxford can be found here
source.notes: MATERIAL FINDING: the official Global constituency page states the Global Rhodes Scholarships are SUSPENDED with immediate effect. Because the programme is not being awarded, no Global application deadline exists - there is nothing to date, and no deadline may be inferred from the general Rhodes cycle. The page carries a site-wide banner reading 'Applications for the Rhodes Scholarship 2027 are open!' but that banner is constituency-agnostic and is contradicted, for the Global constituency specifically, by the suspension notice on the very same page; it is therefore not evidence of a Global deadline and is NOT treated as a source conflict, because neither text states a date for the same deadline. The constituency-lookup page (https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/scholarships/applications/) was also fetched and resolves constituencies only via a JavaScript country selector, so it publishes no Global deadline either. The shard's cached deadline_display ('Varies by constituency (Global deadline ~late August/September 2026 for 2027 entry)') is not supported by the live official source.

rejected_sources.reason: Constituency selection is JavaScript-driven; the page body contains no deadline table and no Global entry. Yields no value for the Global constituency.

source.as_of: Convocatoria II-2026 (official Bases document, 8 pages, published in the site's 2026/07 upload path)
source.raw_extract:
BECAS COLOMBIA BIODIVERSA 
CONVOCATORIA II – 2026 
Abierta desde el 5 de agosto hasta el 5 de octubre 
BASES

4. Procedimiento 

Para participar por una de las Becas del Fondo Colombia Biodiversa los estudiantes interesados deben realizar el siguiente procedimiento: 
a. Preinscripción:  

Consiste en diligenciar el formulario de preinscripción en línea. Disponible desde las 8.00 a.m. del 5 de agosto y hasta las 5:00 p.m. del 5 de octubre de 2026.

El plazo máximo para realizar la preinscripción  vence a las 5:00 p.m. del 5 de octubre de 2026. Una vez el estudiante haya terminado de diligenciar el formulario y cargado o subido debidamente los archivos solicitados, recibirá vía correo electrónico un número de preinscripción.
source.exact_deadline_wording: El plazo máximo para realizar la preinscripción  vence a las 5:00 p.m. del 5 de octubre de 2026.
source.notes: CLOSING DATE FOUND, contrary to the shard's cached expectation. The record's official_source_url (the FAAE application-instructions page) was fetched first and, as the shard noted, publishes no closing date of its own - but that same official page links the authoritative document for this call: 'Consulte aquí las Bases de la convocatoria II-2026' -> https://www.faae.org.co/colombiabiodiversa/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/BasesBecasColBioII2026.pdf. The Bases were downloaded from the provider's own domain and read directly (text extracted from the PDF, not a search snippet); they state the closing date three separate times: the cover line 'Abierta desde el 5 de agosto hasta el 5 de octubre', the procedure section 'Disponible desde las 8.00 a.m. del 5 de agosto y hasta las 5:00 p.m. del 5 de octubre de 2026', and the explicit 'El plazo máximo para realizar la preinscripción vence a las 5:00 p.m. del 5 de octubre de 2026'. The year is stated as 2026 in the procedure text itself, and the record is Convocatoria II-2026, so the closing date is 2026-10-05 at 17:00 Colombia time (UTC-5). Timeliness note for the integrator: retrieval was 2026-10-05T15:29Z = 10:29 Colombia time, i.e. the call was still open at retrieval but closes the SAME DAY at 17:00 COT - this value will go stale within hours and should be re-verified before any user-facing publication. The page's other date line, 'Convocatoria I - 2026, abierta del 15 de enero al 20 de marzo', describes the PREVIOUS call and was deliberately not used. The preinscripcion form page itself was also checked and is stale (titled 'Convocatoria I-2024'), so it was not relied on.
